visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a person using a gold-colored fork to poke the yolks of two raw eggs sitting in a grey, two-compartment plastic microwave cooker. Yellow captions appear at the top. (2) A man wearing a grey sweatshirt and a black baseball cap with a white logo holds the product packaging, which shows a picture of the egg cooker. (3) The man's hands are seen pouring clear liquid from a translucent measuring cup into the grey compartments of the open egg cooker. (4) The man cracks a fresh egg into one of the compartments. (5) He uses the gold fork again to carefully poke several small holes into the surface of the raw egg yolks within the grey tray. (6) The man places the closed grey cooker into a white microwave oven located on a wooden shelf in a kitchen-like setting. (7) He opens the microwave, lifts the lid of the cooker to release a cloud of steam, then closes it and presses buttons on the microwave interface. (8) He retrieves the cooker and opens it to reveal two cooked eggs; the yolks appear somewhat uneven. (9) The man stands in front of a white wall with kitchen shelves, holding the opened cooker and speaking directly to the camera with an expressive facial expression. (10) A close-up shows a white plate piled high with several microwave-cooked eggs, showing varying degrees of doneness. (11) Back in the kitchen, the man holds a small, white ceramic bowl and prepares to demonstrate another method. (12) He cracks an egg into the small white bowl and pokes the yolk with a fork. (13) He places the bowl into the microwave and covers it with a large, translucent plastic splatter guard. (14) The man takes the bowl out and uses a pink spatula to flip a perfectly shaped, smooth-surfaced poached egg onto a bright yellow plate. (15) He takes a bite of the egg with a fork, looking satisfied and nodding towards the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日本 3COINS 微波爐煎蛋神器. [Variety]: 智商稅?. (2) [Subtitle]: 完美太陽蛋?. [Logo]: KITINTO Double Egg Cooker. (3) [Variety]: (按照說明書步驟) 加入一些水. (4) [Variety]: 打入雞蛋. (5) [Variety]: (防止蛋黃破裂) 用叉子戳幾個洞. (6) [Variety]: 微波爐 600瓦 加熱 30秒 熱氣排出後 再加熱 40秒. (7) [Subtitle]: 究竟... 有沒有成功呢. (8) [Variety]: 努力加熱到蛋熟. (9) [Subtitle]: 有沒有完美我不知道 但是... 一顆熟度看起來剛好 另一顆差一點點. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們大概試了 5、6 次 我們現在有一個蛋山. (11) [Subtitle]: 結論就是我們要用常溫蛋 水不要加太少 加太少不會熟. (12) [Subtitle]: 那如果你沒有去日本 有一個平常自己會用 微波爐做蛋的方式. (13) [Subtitle]: 準備可微波小碗 打入雞蛋. (14) [Subtitle]: 用叉子戳幾個洞 微波爐 1000瓦 40秒. (15) [Subtitle]: 蓋上防噴蓋. (16) [Subtitle]: 我覺得比 3COINS 神器好 太美了太美了 真的很漂亮. (17) [Subtitle]: Perfect. (18) [Variety]: 什麼神器? 這才是神器.
